title: Story premise EDU064: The Cable Name Travels to Both Ends
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (home organization). Hook: Which of these ends belongs to that screen? Takeaway/theme: A useful connection label can be read at the point where identification is needed.
description: A desk owner wants to identify a device cable, but a tangled bundle hides its destination. In a de-energized diagram, matching labels at both ends reveal the connection without guesswork.
